description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Lang` which performs post-processing transformations on HTML element attributes, specifically synchronizing the 'lang' and 'xml:lang' attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Lang
classes.description: A class that handles copying the value of 'lang' attribute to 'xml:lang' and vice versa within HTML element attributes to keep language declarations synchronized.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the attributes by copying 'lang' to 'xml:lang' if 'lang' is set and 'xml:lang' is not, or vice versa.
